intro.title: Your journey through the cosmos starts here
intro.text: Look up and explore the wonders of the universe with your personal Night Sky Guide. Discover stars, constellations, planets, and celestial events while learning the secrets and stories behind the beauty of the night sky. Whether you're a curious beginner or a passionate stargazer, your journey through the cosmos starts here with us.

experiences.title: Stars & constellations
experiences.text: Learn to find your way around the sky — from the Plough to Orion — with the naked eye.

experiences.title: Planets & the Moon
experiences.text: Spot the planets wandering among the stars and see craters and rings through a telescope.

experiences.title: The Milky Way
experiences.text: On a clear, moonless night our galaxy arches across the sky from horizon to horizon.

experiences.title: Myths & stories
experiences.text: Hear the legends, folklore and science behind the sky our ancestors watched for millennia.

reserve.title: Kerry International Dark Sky Reserve
reserve.body:
Located along Ireland’s stunning Wild Atlantic Way, the Kerry International Dark Sky Reserve is the only Gold Tier dark sky reserve in the Northern Hemisphere and offers some of the darkest and most spectacular night skies in the world.

Far from the glow of city lights, visitors can admire countless stars, spot constellations, and experience the Milky Way stretching across the sky. It’s a magical destination for stargazers, nature lovers, and anyone wishing to discover the wonders of the universe.
